== Assets ==

=== Old Laptop ===

The '''[[Arma 3 CfgVehicles EMPTY#Land_Laptop_02_unfolded_F|"Land_Laptop_02_unfolded_F"]]''' Old Laptop has an action to "Get Back to Main Menu" when the mission date is set to 2001-06-22 ({{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}} release date).
Completing the action causes the Old Laptop to display a video showcasing the {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}}'s main menu. The [[BIS_fnc_laptopInit]] function can be used to apply this Easter Egg on other computers.

[[File:A3 Tanoa Galaxy.jpg|thumb|200px|Galaxy in chimney]]
=== Chimney's galaxy ===

Some {{arma3}} performance issues can be explained by the fact the [[Real Virtuality]] engine has to render '''a whole galaxy''' in '''[[Arma_3_CfgVehicles_Structures#Land_SCF_01_chimney_F|"Land_SCF_01_chimney_F"]]''' Sugar Cane Factory chimney tower.

[[File:arma3-predator_easter_egg_ancient_head.jpg|thumb|200px|''There's something out there waiting for you, and it ain't no man...'']]
=== Predator ===

An ancient statue makes the sound of the {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Predator_(film)|Predator}} - stay on your toes.


{{Clear}}
[[File:livonian christmas trees.jpg|thumb|An LDF soldier looking up trees with Christmas ornaments.]]
=== Merry Christmas! ===
On December 24th and 25th in [[systemTime|system time]], some of the trees in Livonia get Christmas ornaments.


{{Clear}}
== Missions/Campaigns ==

=== Dutch flag and oranges ===

In one of the IDAP tents that you see at the beginning from the van of Remnants of War, there are small dutch flags and a couple of oranges, which usually one can not see during gameplay.
This is a reference to the fact that [[Arma 3 Laws of War]] (codename ''orange'') is made by the [[Bohemia Interactive]] Amsterdam Studio.
